SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE FOR MARKET RESEARCH ONLY  – This Notice does not constitute a solicitation announcement or restrict the Government to an ultimate acquisition approach and NO AWARD will occur from this Notice.  

 This is a SOURCES SOUGHT Notice to determine the capabilities of both small AND large business firms. Qualified companies, regardless of their size or socio-economic status, are encouraged to respond.  Two or more small business firms capable of performing this work may help to guide the acquisition strategy and influence potential set-aside.  Businesses are strongly encouraged to review this SOURCES SOUGHT and submit according to the directions in this notice. 

 The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement for this requirement. Based on the responses to this sources sought notice/market research, this requirement may be set-aside for small businesses (in full or in part) or procured through full and open competition. All small business set-aside categories will be considered. Both Large and Small Business firms who are interested are encouraged to respond to this Sources Sought Notice. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted nor acknowledged, and no feedback or evaluations will be provided to companies regarding submissions. This is NOT a Request for Proposal (RFP) or Invitation for Bid (IFB) and is for market research purposes only. 

  Project Description:  

 The United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Detroit District is seeking qualified Contractors to rehabilitate and modernize the historic Maintenance Support Building (MSB) west parking lot at the Soo Locks facility in Sault Ste. Marie, Chippewa County, MI. With an estimated construction range between $1,000,000 and $5,000,000, this project includes concrete paving, utility demolition, stormwater management, and physical security upgrades. The site carries a historic designation, so the design includes specialized fencing and lighting as well as relocation of two large concrete pylons at the entry drive. 

 The scope requires the complete demolition of the existing concrete lot, removal of designated trees, and installation of new reinforced concrete pavement. Paving design and materials will generally follow Michigan Department of Transportation (MDOT) standards. Fencelines will be relocated to accommodate overflow parking and snow storage using fabricated ornamental black fencing. The existing stormwater collection system will be removed and replaced in its entirety. The Contractor will demolish an existing transformer and associated feeds, and connect new parking lot lighting, gate operators, and security systems to stubs from an electrical panel. 

 Security improvements include providing a reconfigured sallyport-style vehicle entry using two motorized vehicle gates. A new steel-cable vehicle crash restraint system will be installed on the front fenceline, along with security cameras and a secure pedestrian entrance. The scope will include a new foundation and infrastructure for which to place a government-furnished guard shack. 

  NO SOLICITATION, SPECIFICATIONS, OR DRAWINGS are available for this Notice.  

  NAICS Code:  237990 –  Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction  with a size standard of $45,500,000.00. 

  Instructions : 

 Please complete the attached Sources Sought Survey and return it via email to the points of contact listed below. Failure to provide a complete response may result in the Government being unable to adequately assess your capabilities. Any information submitted by Respondents to this Sources Sought synopsis is voluntary. As stipulated in Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation Overhaul (RFO) 15.101, responses to this Notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. Any information submitted by Respondents to this Sources Sought synopsis is voluntary and will not be returned. The Government will not reimburse any costs incurred or associated with the submission of information in response to this Notice. The decision to solicit for a contract shall be solely within the Government's discretion. 

 Additional company capability information is welcome. Your company’s response is limited to 5 pages. All attachments must be provided in either Microsoft Word, Excel, or Adobe Acrobat PDF format. Attachments with files ending in “.zip” or “.exe” are not allowable and files will be stripped and deleted from any emails received by the Government. Ensure only .pdf, .docx, or .xls(x) documents are attached to your email. Please send responses no later than  2:00 PM EST  on  December 8th, 2026 . PLEASE REFERENCE  “SOURCES SOUGHT: MSB Parking Lot Renovation”,  in the subject line. 

 Please respond to Sources Sought Survey in the attachment and email it to LRE-Proposal@usace.army.mil, sally.e.artz@usace.army.mil, and michelle.barr@usace.army.mil. 

  

 If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us via the aforementioned email addresses. Your prompt attention and response to this Notice is greatly appreciated. All data received in response to this Sources Sought that is marked or designated as corporate or proprietary will be fully protected from any release outside the Government.
